summary: LSF job 9740323 is DONE and the canonical five-internal-image NSW=1 local VASP micro-NEB pilot validator passes. All internal images completed normally and electronically converged, magnetic continuity has no warning, and the PBC-unwrapped final geometry preserves a continuous O-H forming path. The pilot forces are intentionally unconverged; no formal local ordinary NEB is yet authorized or submitted.

payload.objective: Obtain separate user authorization before preparing and submitting the formal local VASP ordinary micro-NEB on the pilot-validated seven-image path.
current_evidence: LSF job 9740323 is DONE on sunboquan-codex.
The canonical pilot validator passes all five internal images: normal completion, electronic convergence, exactly one ionic step, complete required outputs, and current live DONE evidence.
No magnetic-continuity warning is present; total magnetization decreases smoothly from 106.288182 to 105.795278 muB across images 01-05.
The one-step energy maximum is image 03 while the maximum NEB force is image 04 at 4.428662 eV/A; this mismatch and the large forces are expected to require formal optimization.
Raw VASP CONTCAR files wrap several movable Fe atoms across the fractional 0/1 boundary; minimum-image review copies pass geometry with maximum adjacent atom step 0.417256 A.
nebmovie.pl 1 and top/side visual review show continuous O-H formation and a preserved C1-C2-O-H48 framework.
The NSW=1 energies and forces are diagnostic only and cannot be reported as a barrier or used as a Dimer parent.
